implementation: Experimental frno7 R5900 Linux-user QEMU fork

sources.name: keycodemapdb
sources.provenance: Exact gitlink commit in the pinned QEMU source tree; included because configure requires its README even for user-only builds

checksum_provenance: SHA256 calculated from the commit-specific HTTPS archives on 2026-10-01; no moving branch is used for subsequent downloads
limitations: This is a pinned experimental QEMU 5.0.1 fork, not current upstream QEMU.
The 93 vector multimedia MMI instructions and LQ/SQ are unsupported.
Linux-user translates guest syscalls to the host kernel; it does not execute the eeLinux kernel.
LL/SC and selected reserved instructions are emulated directly, so successful tests do not validate PS2 kernel trap emulation.
There is no PS2 system-mode, GS, IOP, SMAP Ethernet or other PS2-device emulation.
The loader prefix is not a filesystem sandbox; tests use selected programs and host temporary files only.
